description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application that includes a spinner widget. The activity initializes the spinner with weather options, persists the selected position using SharedPreferences, and restores it upon activity creation. It handles user interaction with the spinner to save the selection state, which can be used for testing or restoring UI state.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a spinner with weather options and persists the user's selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the activity UI, initializes the spinner with previous selection if available, and registers a listener to save the new selection.
